run_hydra_app: run a Hydra app that pickles task and Hydra config to the output directory

test_hydra_config_get: test the HydraConfig.get() call to retrieve the current Hydra runtime configuration
refactor_my_app: refactor the my_app function to customize what config objects get pickled to disk
review_pickle_cfg: review the pickle_cfg helper function and its usage for serializing DictConfig and HydraConfig
